easy.title: Rigel
easy.line: Brightest star in the constellation Orion

easy.text: Rigel is the brightest and most massive component – and the eponym.

medium.title: Rigel
medium.line: Brightest star in the constellation Orion

medium.text: Rigel is a blue supergiant star in the equatorial constellation of Orion.
A much fainter star, separated from Rigel and the others by nearly an arc minute, may be part of the same star system.
